description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeeTerminationRecordDecorator, which serves as a decorator for the EmployeeTerminationRecord entity within the OrangeHRM system. The class provides methods to format termination record data and set termination reasons by ID, utilizing traits for ORM helpers and date formatting.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationRecordDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeTerminationRecord entity, providing additional methods for data formatting and relationships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeTerminationRecord instance.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date of the termination record, or null if not available.

methods.name: setTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Sets the termination reason for the employee record based on the provided ID.
